trust_decision.summary: The browser decides, not the server: the MIME type in a paste-supplied data: URI is parsed client-side, handed to Blob(), and that blob URL is set as the download anchor's href, so only the client can force a non-rendering type on the download blob while keeping the original type for sanitized previews; no PHP code ever sees the attachment payload.

landing_point.why: The report names the attachment download link; AttachmentViewer.setAttachment is the only place the download anchor exists and the only place a blob carrying the paste-supplied MIME type is built and attached to href.

fix_sites.module_kind: client-side JS helper (getBlobUrl, private to the AttachmentViewer IIFE)
client-side JS sink (download anchor href built from the attacker MIME blob)
client-side JS sanitiser (SVG blob rebuilt but the anchor href from line 3005 is never updated)
client-side JS wrapper (re-hosts the same blob href and download name in the editor)
client-side JS alternate route (raw data: URI and its parsed MIME type, no blob created)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The editor preview path only renders files the user picked locally or cloned themselves, so a solver can argue it cannot carry a fresh attacker MIME type and leave it alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: One blob URL serves both the download link and the inline preview (image/video/audio/PDF), and the clone flow re-reads that same blob URL and re-encodes it with FileReader, which stamps the blob's type into the new data URI; forcing a single safe type on the blob silently breaks preview rendering and strips the MIME type from cloned attachments.

MIME prefix taken as attachmentData.substring(5, indexOf(';')) (js/privatebin.js:3214-3221)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second download-link producer: moveAttachmentTo already accepts an arbitrary href + filename pair and re-hosts it in the editor.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the natural place a maintainer would add 'attach this data URI directly' support for clones, comments or re-sharing, without going through getBlobUrl.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A parallel consumer that parses the MIME type with getAttachmentMimeType and hands the raw data URI to the preview renderer, bypassing getBlobUrl entirely.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists for the editor preview tab, so a maintainer extending previews to new types would naturally add a second copy instead of reusing the download path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A save/reload path where the blob is fetched and re-encoded by FileReader, carrying the dangerous type into a new paste payload.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The clone feature needs the attachment bytes back from the blob URL and the browser is the only thing that knows the type, so a maintainer would keep using blob.type there.

O9_family: stored/DOM-based XSS via attacker-controlled MIME type (CWE-79/CWE-80): active content (e.g. text/html, image/svg+xml) navigated from a blob: URL in the PrivateBin origin

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the single Blob type in getBlobUrl to application/octet-stream for every attachment, which closes the download link but breaks previews and strips the type from cloned attachments.
